sights.w: Taishō-era former Tobita yūkaku brothel building, now a working ryōtei; its lavish interiors are a nationally Registered Tangible Cultural Property (2000) and the go-to place in Japan to step into the world of Demon Slayer's Entertainment District arc, since nothing comparable survives in Tokyo's old Yoshiwara.
sights.anime: Demon Slayer (Kimetsu no Yaiba) — Entertainment District (Yūkaku-hen) arc: surviving Taishō pleasure-quarter interiors featured by Mapple as the arc's real-world pilgrimage spot

sights.address: 13F, South Gate Building (LUCUA SOUTH), 3-1-1 Umeda, Kita-ku, Osaka
sights.w: Capcom's third store and first Kansai café (opened Nov 2022) — ~900 Monster Hunter / Resident Evil / Street Fighter goods plus a 56-seat rotating collab café; still trading in 2026 (Ōkami 20th-anniversary collab, June 2026) after the building's 13F became LUCUA SOUTH.
sights.anime: Capcom (Monster Hunter, Resident Evil, Street Fighter, Ōkami) — the publisher's only Kansai store-café, Osaka being Capcom's home city
